title: SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS FOR LOTS WITH PRIVATE ROADS

blocks.html: To provide for the orderly development of residences that are distant from streets, site planning requirements are established in Sections 26-20 through 26-27, inclusive. The regulations of this Section are intended to:
blocks.plainText: To provide for the orderly development of residences that are distant from streets, site planning requirements are established in Sections 26-20 through 26-27, inclusive. The regulations of this Section are intended to:

blocks.html: (a)        optimize vehicular access within and among zoning lots containing private roads;
blocks.plainText: (a) optimize vehicular access within and among zoning lots containing private roads;

blocks.html: (b)        regulate the size of and distance between curb cuts to minimize undue conflict between pedestrian and vehicular movement;
blocks.plainText: (b) regulate the size of and distance between curb cuts to minimize undue conflict between pedestrian and vehicular movement;

blocks.html: (c)        provide for sidewalks to facilitate social interaction and enhance pedestrian safety; and
blocks.plainText: (c) provide for sidewalks to facilitate social interaction and enhance pedestrian safety; and

blocks.html: (d)        provide for tree planting along private roads in order to enhance the visual and environmental character of the neighborhood.
blocks.plainText: (d) provide for tree planting along private roads in order to enhance the visual and environmental character of the neighborhood.
